string-array.name: doc_guidelines
string-array.item: #Be kind first
Everyone here is a stranger to someone. Write the way you would want to be written to. Disagree without insults.
#Adults only
You must be 18 or older. Report anyone who seems younger.
#No harassment
No threats, bullying, hate speech or repeated messages after someone stops replying. A request without an answer is an answer.
#Consent matters
Do not send sexual content or ask for it. Do not share photos of other people without their permission.
#Keep it honest
Use your own photos and your real age. No fake profiles, no pretending to be someone else, no scams or selling.
#Protect each other
Never ask for passwords, codes, money or bank details. If someone asks you, report them.
#What happens when rules are broken
Reported content is reviewed. Depending on what happened we may remove content, limit messaging, or close the account.

string-array.name: doc_privacy
string-array.item: #What this version stores

Your profile, posts, highlights, journal, messages, reports and settings are stored on this device in app private storage. Photos you add are copied into that storage and re-encoded, which removes location and camera details.
#Who can see what

Your profile, posts, highlights and public journal entries are visible to other members. Private journal entries are only visible to you and can be protected with a passcode. Your passcode is stored as a salted hash, never as plain digits.
#Permissions

Microphone access is used only while you record a voice intro. Notification access is used for message and activity alerts. Photos are picked with the system photo picker, so the app never sees the rest of your library.
#Your controls
You can deactivate your profile at any time to hide it. Deleting your account removes your profile and everything you created from this device right away.

string-array.name: doc_terms
string-array.item: #Using the app
You must be 18 or older and follow the community guidelines. You are responsible for what you post and send.
#Your content
You keep ownership of what you create. You allow the app to store and show it to other members so the service works.
#Accounts
We may limit or close accounts that break the guidelines. You can delete your account whenever you want from Settings.
#Plus
Plus adds features to your account for as long as the plan is active. Cancelling stops renewal; features stay until the end of the paid period.
